boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented SRU spaces for quiet work, collaboration, outdoor breaks, and informal gathering.

cards.title: Bailey Library First-Floor Common Area
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · collaborative study space
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the first-floor common area when conversation and shared work fit your study plan.
cards.short_summary: A library option designed for collaborative work with some ambient activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies Bailey Library's expansive first-floor common area as a place where students can collaborate and work with ambient sound.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm library access and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Bailey Library Third-Floor Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · quiet study space
cards.notes: Choose an individual desk by the column windows when you need a quieter setting for reading, writing, or review.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor with individual desks facing column windows.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes Bailey Library's third floor as a designated quiet floor with individual desks facing the column windows.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm library access and hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bailey Library Second-Floor Individual Learning Spaces
cards.title: Bailey Library Individual Learning Spaces
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · second floor
cards.notes: Check the second floor early if a private room helps you focus; SRU describes these spaces as first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Six private individual learning spaces on the library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU reports that Bailey Library has six individual learning spaces on the second floor available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Availability is first-come, first-served; confirm library access and hours.

cards.entity_name: Robert M. Smith Student Center Ballroom Entrance
cards.title: Smith Student Center Ballroom Entrance
cards.subtitle: Robert M. Smith Student Center · third floor
cards.notes: Use the couches near the third-floor Ballroom entrance for a window-side work session overlooking lower campus.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor seating near the Ballroom entrance and campus-facing windows.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies couches near the third-floor Smith Student Center Ballroom entrance as a study area with views over lower campus.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: The Student Center posts building hours; check access before going.

cards.title: Miller Theater Lobby
cards.subtitle: Performing Arts Center · Miller Theater
cards.notes: Set up at a table, chair, or couch in the lobby when you want an open indoor space between classes.
cards.short_summary: An open Performing Arts Center lobby with tables, chairs, and couches.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU states that the Miller Theater lobby in the Performing Arts Center offers tables, chairs, couches, and study space.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Check Performing Arts Center access around performances and scheduled events.

cards.title: Spotts World Culture Building Room 213
cards.subtitle: Spotts World Culture Building · overlooking The Quad
cards.notes: Use this designated student study room for a focused session; its windows face The Quad, according to SRU’s study guide.
cards.short_summary: A designated academic-building study room with windows toward The Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies Room 213 in Spotts World Culture Building as a designated student study room with windows facing The Quad.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and room availability before visiting.

cards.title: Student Government Association Gazebo
cards.subtitle: The Quad · outdoor gathering space
cards.notes: Take work outdoors at the Gazebo when weather allows and some natural background activity will not interrupt your task.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor structure on The Quad for informal, open-air study.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies the Student Government Association Gazebo on The Quad as an outdoor option for studying and social interaction.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and scheduled campus activity may affect use.

cards.title: Macoskey Center Ecotherapy Garden
cards.subtitle: Robert A. Macoskey Center for Sustainable Systems Education and Research
cards.notes: Walk to the ecotherapy garden for a contemplative outdoor break, then settle near the spiral steppingstones to reset between tasks.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor garden with spiral steppingstones at SRU’s Macoskey Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes an ecotherapy garden with monastic-style spiral steppingstones at the Macoskey Center and notes its nearby trails.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Use marked paths and check conditions before heading outdoors.

cards.title: North Hall Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: North Hall · indoor lounge
cards.notes: Start in the Fireplace Lounge for an indoor work break, then move to the adjacent courtyard if you want fresh air.
cards.short_summary: A North Hall lounge paired with convenient access to the courtyard.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies North Hall’s Fireplace Lounge as a study location and notes that students can easily move from it to the courtyard.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm North Hall access before visiting.

cards.title: North Hall Courtyard
cards.subtitle: North Hall · reservable outdoor campus space
cards.notes: Use the courtyard as an outdoor pause between classes or pair it with time in North Hall’s Fireplace Lounge nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named courtyard beside North Hall that also serves campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU’s Student Center office identifies North Hall Courtyard as an outdoor campus space available to reserve, and SRU’s study guide links it with North Hall’s Fireplace Lounge.
cards.access_notes: May be reserved for events; check conditions and access before visiting.
